blocks.text: We agree with you about the word "audit." To an investor it can suggest that something has gone wrong, and that is not the impression we want the note to leave. We will describe the conversations instead as part of a periodic review of how {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}} communicates with the people who follow it, which is accurate and, in our experience, far less likely to prompt an anxious call.

We would also suggest one addition, if you are comfortable with it. A sentence stating that we will not discuss results, outlook, or anything the company has not already made public tends to put investors at ease, and it gives you some protection as well.
Michelle will send you the draft with both changes marked, so that you can approve it in a single pass.
